bandReport.notes: p00 IS the instructions cover (T.B.C. RAKU-S-GKL, Test Booklet Series A, GENERAL KNOWLEDGE, 120 items, 100 marks, two hours) — NOT transcribed. Rendered pages are the ENGLISH half only: p01=printed p3, p02=p5, p03=p7, p04=p9, p05=p11 — the odd printed pages, with the Hindi half on the intervening even pages, visible only as show-through ghosting. Band is Q1-35, contiguous, no gaps. Q1 is the first question of the paper and is complete on p01. Q35 is complete on p05 (its option (d) closes at the foot of the right column). Band-edge checked forward: p06 opens fresh with Q36 in the left column and Q40 in the right, so nothing of mine spills into B2 and nothing of B2's begins on p05. Per-page split: p01=Q1-10, p02=Q11-17, p03=Q18-24, p04=Q25-30, p05=Q31-35. NO shared 'Directions:' code block anywhere in this band — every question carries its own four options, and the four code-style items (Q21, Q25, Q27, Q34) each print their own 'Select the answer using the code given below :' line plus their own options. Two Match Lists (Q17, Q31); both code tables were re-read at 9x from the source PDF and confirmed digit by digit. TWO PRINTED DEFECTS, both verified at 8-10x: Q12 prints every nuclide symbol as a bare C (carbon) where Cl (chlorine) is meant, in all four options; Q20 option (a) is printed 'Chloride', so as printed none of its four options is a paper-bleaching agent. Q28 prints decimals with a raised mid dot (0.5 as 0·5). No option block in this band splits across the column break.
